children: Boulder, Colorado--(Newsfile Corp. - September 24, 2026) - FST Corp.

("FST" or the "Company"), a leading manufacturer and marketer of steel and graphite golf shafts and a provider of other golf-related services, today announced the launch of the KBS TOUR V-X family of steel iron shafts, comprising the KBS TOUR V-X and KBS TOUR V-X Lite.

The V-X family represents the Company's newest steel iron shaft platform, engineered to maximize the strength-to-weight ratio while maintaining the signature KBS feel. Its proprietary flex profile and geometric design allow KBS to deliver greater stiffness and stability at a given shaft weight, providing more precise control of shaft deflection through impact. In Company testing, the family achieved a strength-to-weight ratio up to approximately 20% higher than many of the Company's existing steel iron shafts.

Both shafts share a common architecture: a firm butt section, a responsive midsection, and a stable tip profile designed to reduce bending amplitude across the swing. By reducing movement at impact, the Company believes the platform delivers truer flight, tighter dispersion, and improved distance control for players with faster swing speeds, without sacrificing the workability competitive golfers require.
The family's two weight platforms allow fitters to match a player's preferred feel and swing profile:
KBS TOUR V-X

The heavier platform in the family, designed for advanced and elite players seeking maximum stability and a traditional, firmer steel feel. The TOUR V-X offers low-launch, low-spin characteristics and is intended for players who have tested the V-X Lite and want more mass.
Flexes: R, R+, S, S+, X, and Tour Spec X (TX)
Tip options: .355″ taper tip and .370″ parallel tip
Clubs: 3-iron through 9-iron, pitching wedge, and sand wedge
KBS TOUR V-X Lite

A players' model shaft engineered to bring V-X stability to the lightweight steel category, which has historically required players to trade control for weight savings. The V-X Lite targets what the Company calls the "next generation" player: golfers generating higher clubhead speed who want a lighter platform without sacrificing the piercing flight and tight dispersion associated with heavier steel.
Weights: 90 grams (Regular), 95 grams (Stiff), 99 grams (R/S, parallel tip), 100 grams (X-Stiff, taper tip), and 102 grams (X-Stiff, parallel tip)
Flexes: Regular, R/S, Stiff, and X-Stiff
Finish: Chrome

"The V-X family is a generational step for our steel business," said FST Chief Executive Officer David Chuang. "For years, players who wanted a lighter iron shaft had to accept a loss of stability to get there. Now we offer a platform that is stronger for its weight than any steel iron shaft we have previously built, in both a traditional weight range and a lightweight profile."

"Steel remains the foundation of the KBS brand and the largest contributor to our revenue," Mr. Chuang continued. "Launching the V-X and V-X Lite together allows our fitting network and our OEM partners to serve the full spectrum of competitive players from a single platform, and strengthens our position in the lightweight steel category, where we see meaningful room to grow."
Mr. Chuang added that he expects the V-X family, alongside the Company's 2026 graphite lineup, to make "significant contributions" to FST revenue in the second half of 2026.
Both the KBS TOUR V-X and KBS TOUR V-X Lite are now available and can be ordered through
, authorized KBS fitting partners and distributors, and the Company's KBS Golf Experience retail locations.
About FST Corp.

Founded in 1989, FST Corp. manufactures and sells golf club shafts, along with other golf-related items, to golf equipment brands, OEMs, distributors, and consumers via the Company's KBS Golf Experience retail outlets. FST's equipment, marketed under the KBS brand, is utilized by golfers at all levels, including many professional players participating in the PGA and other major golf associations. The Company's product portfolio, retail presence, and golf-related services are part of a vertically integrated business model that has established the KBS brand on a global scale and created significant competitive advantages over peer brands. The Company's growth strategies currently position it for expansion into under-tapped golf shaft markets.
